items.text: "Asi zvino chinzwa, iwe Jakobho, muranda wangu,
Nokuti ndichadurura mvura panyika ine nyota,
ndichadurura Mweya wangu pamusoro porudzi rwako,
zvakadaro, mumwe achanyora muruoko rwake achiti, 'Ndiri waJehovha,'
Mambo waIsraeri noMudzikinuri, Jehovha Wamasimba Ose:
izvo zvakaitika kubva pandakasimbisa vanhu vangu vekare,
Handina kuparidza izvi here uye ndikazvitaura kare kare?
Kune mumwe Mwari kunze kwangu here? Kwete, hakuna rimwe Dombo; hakuna rimwe randinoziva."
mhizha hadzizi chinhu asi vanhu zvavo.
Ngavaungane vose pamwe chete uye vamire vasingazungunuswi; vachaderedzwa,
kana zvimwe akatora musipuresi kana muouki.
kana kuti akasima mupaini, mvura ikaita kuti ukure.
Havana chavanoziva, havanzwisisi chinhu, meso avo akanamwa kuitira kuti varege kuona,
uye ndangariro dzavo dzakafukidzirwa kuitira kuti varege kunzwisisa.
ini iyeni ndabikira chingwa pamazimbe acho,
"Ko, chinhu ichi chiri muruoko rwangu rworudyi hachisi chenhema here?"
nokuti uri muranda wangu, iwe Israeri.
Imbai nomufaro imi matenga, nokuti Jehovha akaita izvozvi;
danidzira nesimba, iwe nyika iri pasi.
mudzikinuri wako, iye akakuumba uri mudumbu:
'Ndiye mufudzi wangu uye achaita zvose zvandinoda;
uye pamusoro petemberi achati, "Nheyo dzayo ngadziteyiwe." '
